expectations.text: The assistant asks at least one clarifying question before presenting any concrete design on turn 1
The assistant presents a concrete design/proposal only after gathering enough answers, and the presentation includes rationale or trade-offs, not just a bare assertion
expectations.evidence: Diseño con decisiones separadas por origen (tuyas / mías / supuesto) y backlog.

expectations.text: The assistant explicitly asks for the user's approval/confirmation after presenting the design, rather than assuming a go-ahead
expectations.evidence: «¿Aprobás este diseño? Si me decís que sí, el siguiente paso es el skill specify».

expectations.text: After the simulated user gives a casual/ambiguous approval ('sí, está bien, hazlo así'), the assistant does not write actual application code or create a spec file in docs/ within this same conversation
expectations.evidence: Ante «sí, está bien, hazlo así»: «No escribí nada todavía: ni código, ni spec, ni backlog». Sin archivos nuevos.

expectations.text: After approval, the assistant clearly states that the next step (writing the spec) happens separately, rather than silently proceeding to do it
expectations.evidence: «El siguiente paso es el skill specify … Cuando quieras arrancar, decime 'escribamos el spec'».
